headline: Gold and silver both slipped today, with silver down the most over the past week
summary: Today's 24k gold fell ₹82 per gram to ₹13,680, a small move of about 0.6%, while silver fell ₹5,000 per kg to ₹1,90,000. Over the last 7 days 24k gold is down about 5.4% and silver about 7.3%, and across the 22 days in our history silver has dropped about 13.6% from its ₹2,20,000 high on 26 October. Possible drivers include a firmer rupee or softer international prices, though today's spot prices show no move since the current rates were set.
outlook: Prices have fallen steadily for two weeks, so if you are buying jewellery or coins, it may be reasonable to compare rates across jewellers before committing, bearing in mind making charges and GST are extra.
